softwareSystems.name: Flagora
softwareSystems.description: Geography quiz game where players identify countries by their flags and capitals, with training and challenge modes.

containers.name: API Server
containers.description: ASGI server exposing REST endpoints for account and data management, and WebSocket connections for real-time game sessions.

components.name: Core Domain
components.description: Domain models (User, Country, City, Guess, UserStats) and their business services. This is the business logic layer — not the database itself, which is a separate infrastructure concern.

components.name: Game Consumer
components.description: WebSocket endpoint managing real-time game flow — player connection, question delivery, answer validation, and score feedback. Delegates all game logic to the appropriate Game Mode via the registry.

relationships.description: resolves the concrete game mode service for the player's session
calls question generation, answer checking, and streak calculation

components.name: Flag Store
components.description: Redis-backed cache mapping country ISO codes to flag image paths, avoiding repeated database lookups during active game sessions.

components.name: Game Registry
components.description: Registry mapping game mode identifiers to their concrete GameService implementations, enabling dynamic game mode resolution at runtime.

components.name: Auth API
components.description: REST endpoints for registration, login, logout, email verification, and password reset.

relationships.description: reads and writes users and credentials
sends verification and password reset emails

components.name: Player HTTP API
components.description: REST endpoints for user profile management, country and city data queries, and game statistics.

relationships.description: reads and writes users, countries, cities, and game statistics

components.name: Email Service
components.description: Sends transactional emails — account verification, welcome, and password reset — using HTML and plain-text templates.

components.name: Game Mode
components.description: Abstract base and concrete implementations (training and challenge modes) for the game session lifecycle — player authentication, question generation, answer checking, and streak scoring.

relationships.description: reads countries, cities, guesses, and user stats
retrieves cached flag image paths for question rendering
